CREATE TABLE "public"."accountToken" (
  "consumedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "tokenHash" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "accountToken_type_check_ac18db37" CHECK ("type" IN ('PASSWORD_RESET', 'EMAIL_VERIFICATION'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."collection" (
  "collectedById" int4 NOT NULL,
  "collectionDate" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "collectionId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "memberId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "paymentMethod" text DEFAULT 'CASH' NOT NULL,
  "reference" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "collection_paymentMethod_check_1ac18d5d" CHECK ("paymentMethod" IN ('CASH', 'BANK_TRANSFER', 'MOBILE_PAYMENT', 'CHEQUE', 'OTHER'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."guarantor" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "district" text NOT NULL,
  "division" text,
  "fatherName" text,
  "fullName" text NOT NULL,
  "houseOrHolding" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "memberId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "mobileNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "motherName" text,
  "nidNumber" text,
  "notes" text,
  "occupation" text,
  "postOffice" text NOT NULL,
  "relationship" text NOT NULL,
  "road" text,
  "union" text,
  "upazila" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "village" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."loan" (
  "applicationDate" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "approvedAt" timestamptz,
  "approvedById" int4,
  "chargeAmount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "chargeType" text NOT NULL,
  "chargeValue" numeric NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "disbursementDate" timestamptz,
  "firstDueDate" timestamptz,
  "frequency" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "installmentAmount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "installmentCount" int4 NOT NULL,
  "loanId" text,
  "maturityDate" timestamptz,
  "memberId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "principalAmount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "purpose" text,
  "rejectedAt" timestamptz,
  "rejectedById" int4,
  "rejectionReason" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "totalPayable" numeric NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "loan_chargeType_check_66e0b4fc" CHECK ("chargeType" IN ('FLAT', 'PERCENTAGE')),
  CONSTRAINT "loan_frequency_check_a03ca8f9" CHECK ("frequency" IN ('WEEKLY', 'MONTHLY')),
  CONSTRAINT "loan_status_check_921c6596" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'ACTIVE', 'COMPLETED', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."loanInstallment" (
  "amount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dueDate" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "installmentNo" int4 NOT NULL,
  "loanId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "paidAmount" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "paidAt" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "loanInstallment_status_check_b0be9e9f" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'PARTIAL', 'PAID'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."loanPayment" (
  "amount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "collectionId" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "installmentId" int4,
  "loanId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "paymentDate" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "paymentId" text,
  "paymentMethod" text DEFAULT 'CASH' NOT NULL,
  "reference" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "loanPayment_paymentMethod_check_1ac18d5d" CHECK ("paymentMethod" IN ('CASH', 'BANK_TRANSFER', 'MOBILE_PAYMENT', 'CHEQUE', 'OTHER'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."member" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "fatherName" text NOT NULL,
  "fullName" text NOT NULL,
  "guardianName" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "joinDate" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "memberId" text,
  "mobileNumber" text NOT NULL,
  "motherName" text NOT NULL,
  "nidNumber" text,
  "notes" text,
  "occupation" text,
  "photoUrl" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "member_status_check_a34ffd8e" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'INACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."memberAddress" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "district" text NOT NULL,
  "division" text,
  "houseOrHolding" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "memberId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "postOffice" text NOT NULL,
  "road" text,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "union" text,
  "upazila" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "village" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "memberAddress_type_check_4dfe7b6a" CHECK ("type" IN ('PRESENT', 'FATHER_HOME'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."savingsAccount" (
  "accountId" text,
  "closedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "generalSavingsBalance" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "memberId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "openedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "specialSavingsBalance" numeric DEFAULT '0'::numeric NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "savingsAccount_status_check_f94a3a5d" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'CLOSED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."savingsTransaction" (
  "amount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "balanceAfter" numeric NOT NULL,
  "balanceBefore" numeric NOT NULL,
  "collectionId" int4,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "paymentMethod" text DEFAULT 'CASH' NOT NULL,
  "reference" text,
  "savingsAccountId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "savingsType" text NOT NULL,
  "transactionDate" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "transactionId" text,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "savingsTransaction_paymentMethod_check_1ac18d5d" CHECK ("paymentMethod" IN ('CASH', 'BANK_TRANSFER', 'MOBILE_PAYMENT', 'CHEQUE', 'OTHER')),
  CONSTRAINT "savingsTransaction_savingsType_check_5a4888a3" CHECK ("savingsType" IN ('GENERAL', 'SPECIAL')),
  CONSTRAINT "savingsTransaction_type_check_e2220677" CHECK ("type" IN ('DEPOSIT', 'WITHDRAWAL'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."session" (
  "absoluteExpiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "consumedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "familyId" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "jti" text NOT NULL,
  "refreshTokenHash" text NOT NULL,
  "rememberMe" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "replacedByJti" text,
  "revokedAt" timestamptz,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "emailVerifiedAt" timestamptz,
  "fullName" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "password" text NOT NULL,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'MANAGER' NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userName" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "user_role_check_25d457a5" CHECK ("role" IN ('SUPER_ADMIN', 'ADMIN', 'MANAGER'))
)
